QuestionText:
1. Broken down by international trips on which at least one ministerial staff member of the Minister for Indigenous Australians has been present since FY 2022-23, provide a table that contains the following information:
a. The total number of ministerial staff who went on the trip by level (without disclosing any individual's personal information).
b. Cost of airfares for the ministerial staff on the trip.
c. Cost of accommodation for the ministerial staff on the trip.
d. Any other associated travel costs for ministerial staff on the trip.
